newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures slip as NYMEX disappoints.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures slip as NYMEX disappoints.

text.p: IPE Brent slipped in mid-afternoon trade on Thursday and gas oil trimmed its gains after New York contracts disappointed predictions of a further rise.
Dec Brent, expiring at the close of business, was nine cents down at $23.80 a barrel and Jan down 10 cents at $23.24.
Dec gas oil was up $2.75 a tonne at $219 but off its earlier high of $223.
Dealers said profit-taking on the NYMEX heating oil contract after Wednesday's sharp rally had taken the edge off renewed IPE bullishness.
Markets rose swiftly at the end of the session on Wednesday in anticipation of lower U.S. oil inventories in weekly API and EIA reports.
API data showed distillate stocks down 827,000 barrels with heating oil up 120,000.
Falling temperatures in the U.S. northeast and northwest Europe have helped reignite an oil price rally this week.
Wednesday's rally pushed aside several levels of technical resistance leaving chart analysts to include that the bulls are back in control of energy contracts.
Some said a test of mid-October's post Gulf War highs could be on the cards.
